# Code of Conduct

## The short version

Be decent. Disagree about code, not about people.

## What is expected

- Assume the other person is trying to help.
- Critique the change, not its author.
- Accept that a maintainer may decline a contribution, and say why once.
- Respect that people here write in English and Portuguese; neither is a
  second-class language in this repository.

## What is not accepted

- Harassment, insults, or personal attacks.
- Sexualized language or imagery, and unwelcome advances.
- Publishing anyone's private information without their consent.
- Deliberately derailing discussion or wasting reviewers' time.

## Scope

This applies in issues, pull requests, discussions, and anywhere someone is
representing the project.

## Reporting

Email **mikael.muniz@mkmuniz.dev**. Reports stay private. The maintainer will
respond within a week and may warn, remove content, or block an account.

If the report concerns the maintainer, say so — you are entitled to escalate
to GitHub Support instead.

## Attribution

Adapted in spirit from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org),
shortened so it is short enough to be read.
